item.title: Lyme Epidemic
item.author: emecas
item.description:
Lyme Epidemic
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lyme_disease
http://lymestats.org/

Lyme disease is caused by a spiral shaped bacteria (spirochete) called Borrelia. There are 100 different strains of Borrelia in the USA and 300 worldwide. In the USA, Lyme disease is twice as common as Breast Cancer and six times as common as AIDS.
Source: ILADS

item.title: getusvpn: a free US PPTP VPN (2013, gone)
item.author: emecas
item.description:
getusvpn: a free US PPTP VPN (2013, gone)
A free VPN service, as it was in May 2013: everyone used the same PPTP account to connect from Windows, OS X, iPhone, iPad, Android or a router through a server in the USA. The site no longer answers, and PPTP has been considered broken since 2012, so this note is only a record.

http://www.getusvpn.com/1
Archived copy (2013-05-09): http://web.archive.org/web/20130509025235/http://www.getusvpn.com/

Welcome to high quality USA based Free VPN!

Feel free to use the US PPTP VPN in Windows, OSX, iPhone, iPad, Android Phones, Tablets & Routers!

The PPTP connection involves MSCHAP-V2 for authentication and MPPE 128-bit for encryption to give users a very strong protection of their network data
